brief.summary: Adds a day offset to a starting weekday.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a starting weekday name and a day count N, then prints the resulting weekday.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It computes (day + N - 1) % 7, so N = 1 keeps the same day and N = 0 returns the previous day. Saturday is spelled Saterday in the supplied code.
